title: "NOW THE REAL FUN BEGINS!"
situation: Before the October 10 protest, templated posts claim 5 lakh to 10 lakh Hindutva workers will come to Jantar Mantar; one post shows a man with a wooden stick and a convoy leaving a mall at 10 am. Old saffron-scarf footage recirculates as new. The named groups deny it.
where: X, Facebook, Instagram (aimed at Jantar Mantar)

others: a youth group promising "a befitting reply"

lines.text: Protesters called "cockroaches" who should be taught a lesson.
lines.speaker: social media post

paraphrased: Bajrang Dal called the reports "misleading, malicious propaganda".

context: ThePrint live blog for Oct 10 records no actual pro-government counter-protest on the day.

buildThis.situation: Midday rumour on the phone: "DRS ke 5 lakh aa rahe hain"; the truth is six bikes and a megaphone, but the rumour alone shrinks the crowd unless someone films the real size.
